newsitem.title: USA: Triton files $500 mln shelf registration.
newsitem.headline: Triton files $500 mln shelf registration.

text.p: Triton Energy Limited Wednesday said it filed a shelf registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission that provides for the issuance of up to $500 million of debt and equity securities, or combinations thereof. It said the registration statement replaces the shelf-registration statement filed by Triton Energy Corp before the formation of Triton Energy Limited on March 25 as a new parent holding company.
Proceeds from the new registration statement are expected to go toward Triton's exploration and development programs and to satisfy general corporate needs, the company said.

The company has cash and cash equivalents of about $75 million and access to a recently signed $125 million unused bank revolving-credit facility, and therefore sees "no near-term necessity for external funding," said Triton chief financial officer Peter Rugg.
